slides.title: POV: HVAC tech, first cold snap of the year, every furnace in town quits
"3 units with no heat. Can you come today?"
slides.body: "Owner needs your current insurance certificate before you go in."

slides.title: "Sending it now..."
slides.body: "...is it a problem if it says 2025?"

slides.title: First cold snap: furnaces quit, certificates expire.
slides.body: Check your COI, license and workers' comp dates before the busy season, not during it.

slides.title: Every license and policy date in one place
slides.body: CertTrack tracks expirations and alerts you before they expire.
